capabilities: Scan all markdown files for #task checkbox lines
Display tasks in a 2x2 Eisenhower grid plus a backlog
Drag tasks between quadrants to write the #tm/qN tag
Cycle task status by clicking the checkbox
Filter, search, and jump to the source line
extras: Manifest carries the 'not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' disclaimer. README documents conflict-safe atomic writes when files change underneath an action.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in quadrant view for prioritizing checkbox tasks scattered across notes.
summary: Eisenhower-matrix view that gathers #task checkbox lines from the vault into a Do / Schedule / Delegate / Delete grid and writes changes back to the source files.
